title: Previously On with Jillian Bonanne
author: Jillian Bonanne | Previously On Teen TV
description: Follow for breakdowns, recaps, and funny reactions to the top shows of the moment! Hi! I'm Jillian and I host Previously On, with help from my friends and my husband. Each pod we review and joke about our favorite new TV shows. I mostly cover teen dramas, romances, book adaptations... you know the vibe! Posting full video on Spotify and YouTube.
